## Description

<big>Forces one or more players to press a button virtually for a single frame.</big>

## Snippet

```
Press Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
```

> ==**Player**==
> _Type: **[Player](/wiki/articles/player)** | **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[Event Player](/wiki/articles/event+player)**_
> The player or players for whom the virtual button input will be forced.

> ==**Button**==
> _Type: **[Button](/wiki/articles/button-teGoCiTvNd3KF0DC39gWsg)**, Default: **Primary Fire**_
